title: Presence Over Position
goal: Encourage each man to prioritize presence and service over personal position or ambition.
leader_notes: The sermon outlines how Jesus prioritizes presence and service over personal position. The critical teaching here is that true greatness is not about worldly status but about humble service and dependence on God. This mirrors Jesus' actions and teachings in Mark 9:30-50.

A key illustration used was that of Theodore Roosevelt, whose time of hardship and reflection led to his greater transformation and readiness for presidency. This serves as an analogy for how our times of struggle can lead to personal growth if we focus on presence over position.

The sermon addresses common struggles like the need for validation, fear of losing status, and the temptation to neglect presence in favor of position. It emphasizes repentance and God's grace in forming our character, even in challenging circumstances.
scripture_instructions: Read Mark 9:33-37 to set the theme of humility and service before discussion.

icebreakers.label: A
icebreakers.question: Share a time when you had to prioritize a relationship over a personal achievement.

icebreakers.label: B
icebreakers.question: What is one childhood dream of greatness you remember having?

icebreakers.label: C
icebreakers.question: Describe a moment when you felt unexpectedly humbled.

sections.title: The Struggle for Position
sections.setup: The sermon describes how the disciples argue about who is the greatest, demonstrating our natural desire for status. Jesus challenges this by placing a child among them, highlighting service and humility over ambition.
questions: Have you ever found yourself competing for recognition instead of focusing on presence?
When have you replaced seeking God's presence with chasing a promotion or status? How did that affect you?
What fears do you have about losing your status or position?
How has striving for position affected your relationships with others?
reflection_questions: Have I ever found myself competing for recognition instead of focusing on presence?
When have I replaced seeking God's presence with chasing a promotion or status? How did that affect me?
What fears do I have about losing my status or position?
How has striving for position affected my relationships with others?

sections.title: Presence Over Performance
sections.setup: Discussing Jesus' rebuke to the disciples about greatness, the sermon emphasizes serving others without an agenda. True greatness lies in actions driven by genuine service, not personal gain.
questions: Think of a time when you served someone with no expectation of return. How did that change you?
What is one area of your life where you can serve without seeking recognition this week?
When have you seen service without agenda bring unexpected blessings?
How does serving without expectation impact your view of humility?
reflection_questions: Think of a time when I served someone with no expectation of return. How did that change me?
What is one area of my life where I can serve without seeking recognition this week?
When have I seen service without agenda bring unexpected blessings?
How does serving without expectation impact my view of humility?

sections.title: Facing Our Inner Battles
sections.setup: The sermon uses bold metaphors to address the seriousness of sin and temptations. It highlights how tolerating sin impacts our spiritual growth and calls us to actively root it out.
questions: What 'tigers' in your life seem manageable but have the potential to cause harm when left unchecked?
Where have you settled for 'I can handle it' rather than addressing a sin seriously?
How can recognizing the seriousness of sin bring about meaningful change in your life?
What steps can you take to confront and eliminate a recurring temptation?
reflection_questions: What 'tigers' in my life seem manageable but have the potential to cause harm when left unchecked?
Where have I settled for 'I can handle it' rather than addressing a sin seriously?
How can recognizing the seriousness of sin bring about meaningful change in my life?
What steps can I take to confront and eliminate a recurring temptation?

closing_go_around: Each man shares one step they'll take this week to focus on presence over position.
prayer: Pray for humility and the courage to prioritize God's presence and service to others over personal ambition and status.

cheat_sheet.response: Ask someone directly to share their thoughts on the last question.
Refocus the group by summarizing the point being discussed and asking the next question.
Invite others into the conversation by asking if they have a different perspective.
Ask follow-up questions that require specific personal examples.
Acknowledge the emotion, provide space for it, then gently guide back to discussion.

key_themes: Greatness in God's kingdom is defined by humility and service.
Presence is more valuable than position.
Service without agenda leads to true transformation.
Jesus' presence overcomes our fears of losing status.
Facing our sins openly leads to deeper growth.
commitment_prompt: Identify one specific way I will choose service over significance this week and share it with a trusted friend for accountability.
